scenarios.name: own-tapland-enters-untapped
scenarios.why: Meandering River enters tapped, but Horizon Explorer's 'Lands you control enter untapped' is a replacement effect that makes it enter untapped instead.

scenarios.name: without-horizon-explorer-tapland-enters-tapped
scenarios.why: Control scenario: with no Horizon Explorer, Meandering River enters tapped as its own text says.
